_comment: Advisories reviewed and accepted as known risk. Keyed by GHSA id. Every entry needs a reason and an expires date (YYYY-MM-DD) so acceptance is revisited rather than becoming permanent. An expired entry is a hard failure, not a silent pass — renew it deliberately or fix the advisory. Consumed by scripts/audit-check.ts.

exceptions.reason: No upstream fix exists: 0.6.0 is the latest release and is still affected, so npm's only offered remedy is a downgrade to 0.5.8 (giving up ~10 releases of fixes for a moderate issue). Exposure is limited — adm-zip is a devDependency and is not shipped to package consumers, and the vulnerable extractAllTo call is reached only from scripts/sde-ingest.ts, a maintainer-run script operating on the official CCP SDE archive fetched over HTTPS.
